meta.title: Masar – book your coach seat
meta.description: Book intercity coach trips across Syria from your phone and choose your own seat.

home.title: Book your coach seat from your phone
home.tagline: No trip to the bus station needed: find your trip between Syrian cities and pick your seat yourself.

seat.title: Choose your seat
seat.text: See the available seats on the coach map and pick the one you like.

payment.title: Pay the way that suits you
payment.text: Book now and pay cash at the bus station or when boarding. Online payment is coming soon.

home.soon: Search your trip, pick your seats and reserve them. You pay in cash at the bus company counter.
home.citiesUnavailable: The search is not available right now. Please try again in a moment.

results.title: {from} to {to}
results.emptyText: Try another day, or fewer passengers if you are travelling in a group.
results.freeSeats: {count, plural, one {<n>1</n> seat left} other {<n>{label}</n> seats left}}

invalidSearch.incomplete: Please choose a departure city, a destination and a date.
invalidSearch.sameCity: Departure and destination are the same city. Please choose two different cities.
invalidSearch.invalid: This search link is not valid. Please search again.

trip.seatMapHint: The coach is shown from above, with the front at the top.
trip.noFreeSeats: There are not enough free seats on this trip for your search.
trip.chooseMore: {count, plural, one {Choose 1 more seat.} other {Choose {label} more seats.}}
trip.noScript: Please turn on JavaScript to choose seats and book.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: We could not reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: This search is not valid. Please search again.
errors.TRIP_NOT_FOUND: We could not find this trip.
errors.TRIP_NOT_BOOKABLE: This trip can no longer be booked.
errors.SALES_CLOSED: Online sales for this trip have ended. You may still find a seat at the bus station.
errors.INVALID_SEGMENT: These stops do not fit this trip. Please search again.
errors.NO_FARE_FOR_SEGMENT: There is no price for this part of the trip. Please choose another trip.
errors.HOLD_EXPIRED: The time to hold your seats has run out. Please choose your seats again.
errors.CASH_DEADLINE_PASSED: Cash payment is no longer possible for this trip.
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This step is no longer possible for this booking.
errors.BOOKING_NOT_FOUND: We could not open this booking.

lookup.title: My booking
lookup.intro: Enter your booking code and the phone number you used when booking to see your booking and tickets.
lookup.codeHint: 8 letters and digits, as in your booking confirmation.
lookup.notFound: No booking matches this booking code and phone number. Please check both and try again.
lookup.invalid: Please check the booking code (8 characters) and the phone number.

ticket.title: Your ticket

notice.held: Your seats are held until {time} on {date}. Choose how to pay before then, otherwise the seats are released.
notice.heldNoDeadline: Your seats are held for a short time. Choose how to pay, otherwise the seats are released.
notice.reservedCash: Reserved for cash payment. Pay {total} at a {company} ticket counter before {time} on {date}. After that the reservation lapses and the seats are released.
notice.reservedCashNoDeadline: Reserved for cash payment. Pay {total} at a {company} ticket counter before departure.
notice.pending: We are checking your payment. Your tickets appear here once it is confirmed.
notice.confirmed: Your booking is confirmed. Show the QR code of each passenger when boarding.
notice.tripCancelled: The bus company has cancelled this trip. Please contact the company.
notice.cancelled: This booking has been cancelled. The tickets are no longer valid.
notice.expired: This booking has expired and the seats have been released. You are welcome to book again.

ticket.noTicketYet: The ticket with QR code appears once the payment is confirmed.
ticket.forgotten: The ticket has been removed from this device.
ticket.savedHint: This ticket is saved on this device, so you can show it without internet.
ticket.savedOffline: You are offline. This is the copy saved on {date} at {time}.
ticket.savedStale: The ticket could not be refreshed. This is the copy saved on {date} at {time}.
ticket.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open your booking with the booking code and phone number.
ticket.notFound: We could not open this booking. The link may have expired. Please open it again with the booking code and phone number.
ticket.networkError: We could not reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.
ticket.rateLimited: Too many requests in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again.
ticket.noScript: Please turn on JavaScript to see your ticket.

booking.detailsIntro: Enter each name as on the ID card. Staff compare it when you board.
booking.genderHint: Required for every passenger. It does not appear on the ticket.
booking.nationalIdHint: {company} requires it. We store it encrypted.
booking.contactIntro: With your booking code and this phone number you can open your booking at any time under “My booking”.
booking.emailHint: For the booking confirmation by email.
booking.contactNameHint: If left empty, we use the name of passenger 1.
booking.holdHint: Your seats are then held for a few minutes while you choose how to pay.
booking.held: Seats held. Opening the payment step…

phone.invalid: Please enter a valid phone number, for example 0933 123 456.

email.invalid: Please enter a valid email address, or leave the field empty.

seatProblems.SEAT_TAKEN: Someone else has just booked these seats: {seats}. Please choose other seats.
seatProblems.SEAT_BLOCKED: These seats can no longer be booked: {seats}. Please choose other seats.
seatProblems.SEAT_NOT_ONLINE: These seats are only sold at the counter: {seats}. Please choose other seats.
seatProblems.SEAT_UNKNOWN: The seat map has changed. Please choose your seats again.
seatProblems.GENDER_RULE_CONFLICT: These seats are no longer available: {seats}. Please choose other seats.

problems.SEAT_TAKEN: Someone else has just booked one of your seats. Please choose other seats.
problems.SEAT_BLOCKED: One of your seats can no longer be booked. Please choose other seats.
problems.SEAT_NOT_ONLINE: One of your seats is only sold at the counter. Please choose other seats.
problems.SEAT_UNKNOWN: The seat map has changed. Please choose your seats again.
problems.GENDER_RULE_CONFLICT: One of your seats is no longer available. Please choose other seats.
problems.GENDER_REQUIRED: Please choose the gender of each passenger.
problems.NATIONAL_ID_REQUIRED: The bus company requires a national ID number for each passenger. Please reload the page.
problems.TOO_MANY_SEATS: You can book at most 9 seats at once.
problems.TOO_MANY_OPEN_HOLDS: This phone number already has several unpaid bookings. Pay for one of them first or wait until it lapses.

checkout.title: Choose how to pay
checkout.heldFor: Your seats are held for <timer>{countdown}</timer> min more, until {time}.
checkout.cashText: You pay {total} in cash at a {company} ticket counter. Your ticket shows the deadline; if you have not paid by then, the reservation lapses and the seats are released.
checkout.cashDeadlinePassed: Cash payment is no longer possible for this trip, because the deadline for paying at the counter has passed.
checkout.expired: The time to hold your seats has run out and the seats have been released. Please choose your seats again.
checkout.missingToken: This link is incomplete. If you have already reserved, open your booking with the booking code and phone number.
checkout.notFound: We could not open this booking. If you have already reserved, open it with the booking code and phone number.
checkout.networkError: We could not reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.
checkout.rateLimited: Too many requests in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again.
checkout.noScript: Please turn on JavaScript to choose how to pay.

footer.tagline: Intercity coach seats across Syria, booked from your phone.
